patterns: APPSC asks launch current affairs: GSAT-8 launch date (2011), a 'NOT correct about GSAT-30' statement trap (launched to GTO, not sun-synchronous) and foreign heaviest satellites.
Other PSCs ask basics: GEO at a fixed height regardless of mass, a 24-hour period, centripetal force supplied by gravity, INSAT = telecom/meteorological, GSAT-7 = military (Navy).
Recurring facts: INSAT-3C/GSAT-30 launched from Kourou, GSAT-10 was the heaviest in 2012, INSAT-4C (2,168 kg) failed, INSAT-2A launched 10 July 1992.
The app adds many 2024-26 items (CMS-03, GSAT-N2, band uses, DWS), mostly as multi-statement and match items. They are sound but go deeper than APPSC's single-line style.
